This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
• If you're struggling with back pain, stiffness, sciatica pain, or poor posture from long hours of sitting, this gentle beginner-friendly yoga class is designed just for you. At Satvic Yoga, we guide you through simple, safe, and effective asanas using props like a chair and wall support, perfect for all ages — especially if you’re just starting out.
In this video, you'll learn 10 asanas to relieve back pain and improve flexibility:
1. Uttana Shishuasana (Extended Puppy Pose) with Chair
